summary: The Dutch flag carrier, hub at Amsterdam Schiphol; part of Air France-KLM.
checkin: Online check-in opens 30 hours before departure.
baggage: Economy Light, Standard and Flex: 1 small bag (40 x 30 x 15 cm) plus 1 hand baggage (55 x 35 x 25 cm), 12 kg combined. Light tickets include no checked bag. Within Europe, Basic tickets cover only the small bag.
tips: Add hand or checked baggage to a Basic or Light ticket before you fly.
